content.introduction: The Yahoo Finance sector performance dashboards list NU Nu Holdings Ltd., Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc., NVIDIA Corporation, Space Exploration Technologies Corp., and Intel Corporation as the most active stocks. The top gainers include United Therapeutics Corporation, Rogers Corporation, FormFactor, Inc., newcleo plc, and Zeta Global Holdings Corp. The 10-year Treasury yield rose to its highest level since 2007 on September 23, 2026, due to inflation worries. Brent crude oil prices hovered around $96 as analysts warned of a Trump diesel export ban tightening global supply. The Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq sold off on September 23, 2026, as bond yields surged.
